atomic_restatement: CISOs and VPs will maintain 2025-level investment in leadership-acumen sessions during 2026.
indicator: RSAC attendance or session-interest metric for leadership development by seniority
success_threshold: CISO/board and VP/senior-executive relative interest is not lower than the comparable 2025 level
preferred_resolution_source: RSAC 2026 attendance and session-evaluation data with unchanged taxonomy

atomic_restatement: C- and VP-level participants will continue to deprioritize cybersecurity staff development during 2026.
indicator: Comparable RSAC interest or investment metric for team development
success_threshold: Both groups remain at or below the report's defined average or 2025 comparison under the same measure
preferred_resolution_source: RSAC 2026 attendance or survey data with numerator denominator and stable taxonomy

atomic_restatement: Cybersecurity leaders who underinvest in staff development during 2026 will experience costly team departures in 2027.
indicator: Longitudinal departures and replacement cost among the defined leader population
success_threshold: A preregistered population and cost threshold must be available; otherwise indeterminate
preferred_resolution_source: Longitudinal workforce study linking 2026 development investment to 2027 departures

atomic_restatement: CISOs will return to greater workforce-development investment and session interest in 2028.
indicator: Comparable spending and RSAC session-interest measures
success_threshold: Both the specified investment measure and RSAC interest rise over the frozen 2026 baseline
preferred_resolution_source: RSAC 2028 attendance data plus an independent workforce-development spending series

atomic_restatement: In 2026 an average firm will pay 145% more than in 2020 for equivalent cyber-insurance coverage.
indicator: Average premium for equivalent coverage indexed to 2020
success_threshold: 2026 index is at least 245 with 2020 equal to 100 under stable coverage and methodology
preferred_resolution_source: Named market series underlying RSAC Figure 4 or an equivalent documented index

atomic_restatement: Average cyber-insurance premiums will increase by at least 1% during 2026.
indicator: Annual change in an average premium index for equivalent coverage
success_threshold: Calendar-2026 change is at least positive 1.0%
preferred_resolution_source: Named market series underlying RSAC Figure 4 or an equivalent documented index

atomic_restatement: A competent regulator will announce the first EU DORA enforcement action by 2026-04-30.
indicator: Officially announced DORA enforcement action against a violator
success_threshold: At least one qualifying final or formally announced enforcement action by the deadline
preferred_resolution_source: EU or national competent regulator decision or official announcement

atomic_restatement: RSAC focus on remote-work security and remote identity proofing will reach its highest level since 2022 in 2026.
indicator: Share of RSAC Call for Submissions in the frozen remote-work category
success_threshold: 2026 share exceeds each comparable value from 2023 through 2025
preferred_resolution_source: RSAC 2026 Call for Submissions data with stable category definition

atomic_restatement: Cloud-security-only startups will comprise a smaller share of Innovation Sandbox contestants in 2026 than in 2025.
indicator: Share of Innovation Sandbox contestants classified solely as cloud security
success_threshold: 2026 share is below the published 2025 share under the same classification
preferred_resolution_source: Official RSAC Innovation Sandbox entrant list and classification data

atomic_restatement: Supply-chain security startups will comprise approximately 3.7% of Innovation Sandbox entrants in 2026.
indicator: Share of entrants in the frozen supply-chain security category
success_threshold: Observed share rounds to 3.7% at one decimal place
preferred_resolution_source: Official RSAC Innovation Sandbox entrant list and classification data

atomic_restatement: Supply-chain security will comprise approximately 4.3% of RSAC Call for Submissions proposals in 2026.
indicator: Share of complete eligible proposals in the frozen supply-chain security category
success_threshold: Observed share rounds to 4.3% at one decimal place
preferred_resolution_source: Official RSAC Call for Submissions data with numerator denominator and taxonomy

atomic_restatement: Application-security startups will exceed 13% of Innovation Sandbox entries in 2026.
indicator: Share of entries classified as application security
success_threshold: Observed share is greater than 13.0% under the frozen taxonomy
preferred_resolution_source: Official RSAC Innovation Sandbox entry and classification data

atomic_restatement: AI-driven application-security startups will be more than half of application-security startups in Innovation Sandbox 2026.
indicator: AI-driven AppSec entries divided by all AppSec entries
success_threshold: Ratio is greater than 50% under the frozen nested taxonomy
preferred_resolution_source: Official RSAC Innovation Sandbox entry and classification data
